author: Beverage Quality Analysis System (BQAS)

dataset_metadata.citation: P. Cortez, A. Cerdeira, F. Almeida, T. Matos and J. Reis. Modeling wine preferences by data mining from physicochemical properties. In Decision Support Systems, Elsevier, 47(4):547-553, 2009.
dataset_metadata.geographic_origin: Vinho Verde region, Minho, Northwest Portugal
dataset_metadata.target_description: Sensory wine quality rating on a 0-10 scale based on sensory evaluation by at least 3 certified wine experts (median grade).

training_protocol.data_leakage_protection: StandardScaler preprocessing is embedded in scikit-learn Pipeline and fitted exclusively on training splits.
training_protocol.architecture_choice: Separate models trained for Red and White wine because phenolic composition, sulfur dioxide dynamics, and baseline acidity differ systematically between red and white winemaking (Cortez et al., 2009).

limitations_and_disclaimers: Dataset represents Portuguese Vinho Verde wines and may not generalize to other wine regions, grape varieties, vintages, or production methods.
Sensory quality rating estimate only; does not predict health effects, safety, toxicity, or nutritional value.
Not a substitute for official chemical analysis, regulatory compliance certification, or expert sommelier tasting.
Does not measure bouquet, volatile phenols, oak maturation markers, or visual chromatic properties.
